about.title: We make people look twice
about.lede: Vyewfinder Films is an audiovisual production company built on a simple idea: perception determines authority. What people see decides whether they take you seriously.
about.body: We work end to end — direction, cinematography, photography and post — so the story stays intact from the first frame to the final cut. Small team, senior hands, no layers between you and the people doing the work.

timeline.q: How long does a project take?
timeline.a: Most brand films and photo shoots run two to six weeks from kickoff to delivery. Multi-day shoots or campaigns with several deliverables can run longer — we give you a dated schedule before anything is booked.

pricing.a: Projects typically start around $3,500 for a single-day shoot with edit. Final cost depends on crew size, shoot days, locations and how many cuts you need. You get an itemised quote, not a range.

process.q: What does working with you look like?
process.a: A call to understand the goal, then a treatment and quote. Once approved we handle pre-production, the shoot and post. You see a first cut, get two rounds of revisions, and receive final files in every format you need.

travel.a: Yes. We're based in Richmond, VA and shoot regularly across the East Coast and beyond. Travel and lodging are quoted separately and transparently.

rights.a: You do. Final deliverables are yours to use across any channel, in perpetuity. We keep the right to show the work in our own portfolio unless you'd rather we didn't.

podcast.q: Can you produce an ongoing podcast?
podcast.a: Yes — that's a dedicated service. We handle studio setup, multi-cam recording, editing and distribution, either per episode or on a monthly retainer.
